async def act(page):
    # Select the 'express' template by clicking its 'Use template' radio button
    # Use the link with name 'Preview' and URL to identify the correct template
    express_preview_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Preview', url='https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/project-templates/express')
    await express_preview_link.get_by_role('radio', name='Use template').click()
    # Wait for the page to update and form fields to appear
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Fill in the project name
    await page.get_by_label('Project name').fill('web_agent_index')
    # Set visibility to private by clicking the radio button
    await page.get_by_role('radio', name='Private').click()
    # Submit the form to create the repository
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Create project').click()
    # Wait for creation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
